verdict.rationale: MoonPay publishes a comprehensive official Web SDK reference (client init, connect flow, quotes, buy/sell frames, payment methods, credentials) plus an OpenAPI-based codegen guide for type-safe clients, session/quote API endpoints, and demo integration repos with sample code — all clearly documented as first-party SDK/API surfaces developers (including AI-native ones) can build against. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond docs, evidence of SDKs beyond the Web SDK (e.g., mobile/server SDKs), and the OpenAPI spec itself wasn't resolvable at the probed standard paths (moonpay-probe-2), a minor discrepancy with the codegen claim.
